item.tib: dbal chen bsad mdos stag lha me 'bar gyis mdzad pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni me rta zla 3 tshes 30 la/ kho bo dbra rigs bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la dben gnas ma d+hAl ri khrod du/dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis bsnyan ((snyan) du brgyud bzhin yar tshes la nyi shar skabs su gu ger bris pa 'dis kyang / dun tse rtsad nas gcod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
